meta.premiseEvidence: Every candidate premise was grepped against live source before inclusion: navigator.vibrate has zero call sites in src/ despite full touch-control support in MobileHUD.jsx; getArchetypeProgress/getNewlyUnlockedArchetypes in src/utils/buildArchetypes.js are computed but have zero render call sites outside their own module and own test file, and archetypeUnlocksRef resets every run with no localStorage persistence; no minimap/offscreen-indicator/edge-of-screen code exists anywhere in src/; no controlHandedness/leftHanded option exists in SETTINGS_DEFAULTS or MobileHUD.jsx; src/constants.js:756 still contains the literal string 'Pause to read the Bestiary' as a live loading-tip shown to players despite the Session 49 MOST WANTED rename across every other player-facing surface. items.why: archetypeUnlocksRef resets every run in src/App.jsx; unlike the 61 permanent achievements, forging a build doctrine (Trench, Gunslinger, Demolitionist, Tempo, ...) leaves zero lasting trace. This turns an already-shipped, zero-cost classifier into a permanent completionist meta-layer that fits 'Improvised doctrine' — the game keeps receipts on build history without prescribing one correct build.

items.why: getArchetypeProgress (src/utils/buildArchetypes.js) is fully computed but has zero render call sites outside its own module/tests. A player who ends a run one perk short of a capstone gets no signal at all. Purely local/deterministic composition of existing exports, so it is free per SOUL's proof-over-posture cost ethos, and it feeds 'Improvised doctrine' without ever claiming there's one correct build.
